title: Session launching and tracking
summary: Wave 1 design foundation complete. Wave 2 pivots to a local-first manual session registry (issue #9) to deliver restart-resilient session tracking ahead of the launch pipeline. Launch-from-graph and graph overlay follow in Waves 3-4.

nodes.title: Bootstrap design docs
nodes.summary: Create Streamliner's repo-scoped docs/design set from the current root docs and switch this workstream to reference that design layer.

nodes.title: Make workstream design explicit
nodes.summary: Run explicit design sessions for the full workstream so the launch contract, key design decisions, and downstream issue-graph adjustments are written down before more implementation issues are finalized.

nodes.title: Registry-first reorientation
nodes.summary: Reorient the workstream so a manual session registry ships before the launch pipeline. Captures the shift to treating the registry as the primary session surface (graph overlay becomes a projection of it) and reshapes the downstream nodes accordingly. Landed Decision 004 (docs/design/decisions/004-session-registry-primary-surface.md) alongside the brief/graph updates.

nodes.title: Session registry model
nodes.summary: Define the local-first session registry: persisted record shape (id, title, description, color, cwd, repo, status, last-seen, tags), storage layout under the runtime-state root (per-session JSON + index), autosave semantics, and the observation hook that imports existing Copilot CLI sessions from their session state files per decision #001.

nodes.title: Manual session registry UI
nodes.summary: Ship a graph-independent Sessions surface and registry-backed default view: list/create/edit/archive sessions, preserve user-edited identity fields across observation refreshes, surface trusted Copilot/Agency sessions via local plugin signals and context/activity indexing, and keep manual entries supported for sessions not yet discoverable.

nodes.title: Session dashboard multi-instance sync
nodes.summary: Completed: accepted a standalone local Streamliner API process as the session registry synchronization hub. Vite dev/preview frontends proxy `/api/*` to that process; the API owns registry mutation, trusted signal ingestion, background observation/indexing, live session events, and optimistic builder-edit concurrency.

nodes.title: Session relaunch
nodes.summary: Completed: relaunch restores a tracked session at its recorded cwd through the local API. Copilot resume and Windows Terminal tab color remain best-effort enhancements; relaunch correctness is cwd recovery through the primary session registry surface.

nodes.title: Windows Terminal color bridge spike
nodes.summary: Spike completed: Windows Terminal can accept `wt new-tab --tabColor` for new tabs, but there is no reliable CLI contract for recoloring an already-open tab. Wave 2 treats terminal color as optional launch-time presentation metadata; relaunch continues uncolored whenever color application is unavailable or fails.

nodes.title: Backend context assembly
nodes.summary: Completed: a selected ready graph node can produce a launch context package reference for downstream launch code, covering project design context, workstream intent/state, node/tracker context, source references, freshness, and unavailable inputs before the PAW work directory exists. The Wave 3 launch path will place/reference the generated context from the PAW work directory after paw-init.

nodes.title: Launch claim binding
nodes.summary: Completed: PR #42 added the launch-claim subsystem for graph-launched sessions, including the local launch-claim store, reserved registry rows, createLaunchClaim/markClaimFailed, Tier 1 prompt-nonce binding, Tier 2 trusted-hook binding via STREAMLINER_LAUNCH_CLAIM_ID, sweep/diagnostics, read-only launch-claim APIs, and graphBinding on registry rows.

nodes.title: PAW launch configuration and prompt defaults
nodes.summary: Completed: PR #41 added the PAW-only launch preparation flow. The graph action opens an Initialize PAW launch dialog, captures natural-language PAW workflow instructions and reusable prompt-profile snippets, normalizes Copilot CLI args and terminal preferences, runs fully capable SDK paw-init, installs streamliner/context.md under the PAW work directory, exposes bounded WorkflowContext.md review/editing, and returns a structured terminal handoff without starting the visible worker. Rich PAW WorkflowContext configuration UI is deferred to #43.

nodes.title: Terminal launch integration
nodes.summary: Completed: PR #45 closed Wave 3 by adding the API-first node-launch path that consumes the prepared PAW handoff, creates a launch claim before terminal spawn, injects the canonical nonce line and STREAMLINER_LAUNCH_CLAIM_ID, opens a visible Copilot CLI worker through the configured terminal path, surfaces terminal-spawn failures through the claim-failure path, and joins launch-claim state into node launch records to gate duplicate active launches.

nodes.title: Session event observation
nodes.summary: Completed: PR #54 added graph-independent session activity evidence to registry/list surfaces. Downstream consumers can now distinguish active work, idle/needs-input, clean exits, interrupted sessions, and degraded observation confidence through activityEvidence fields for status reason, confidence, diagnostics, pending input, turn-boundary timestamps/counts, process state, and bounded events.jsonl scan metadata while preserving activityStatus compatibility.

nodes.title: Sessions view workstream linkage
nodes.summary: Completed: PR #46 made graph-launched sessions legible from My Sessions. Bound rows now resolve graphBinding against tracked workstreams, show workstream/node chips, support Workstream grouping, deep-link to selected graph nodes when unambiguous and resolvable, and keep unbound/manual sessions first-class with explicit fallback grouping.

nodes.title: Graph node session status indicators
nodes.summary: Render bound session status directly on graph nodes using the same status pulse/pill language as My Sessions. Nodes with active launched sessions show the highest-attention session state and session count, with details linking back to the corresponding Sessions entries.

nodes.title: PAW artifact status observation
nodes.summary: For sessions launched through Streamliner's PAW launch flow or manually linked to PAW artifacts, inspect the PAW work directory and derive coarse workflow status from durable artifacts such as specs, plans, research, implementation phase artifacts, reviews, and PR/finalization artifacts. Copilot session observation remains the source for liveness and attention state; `## Control State` is not authoritative.

nodes.title: Tracker-required launch policy
nodes.summary: Add a configurable launch precondition that can require graph nodes to have an associated tracker issue before Streamliner starts PAW preparation, launch-claim creation, or terminal spawn, with GitHub issue-backed nodes as the first supported policy target and clear UI/API blocking behavior when the policy is enabled.

nodes.title: Runtime overlay in UI
nodes.summary: Compose the linked Sessions and graph-node status surfaces into the committed graph runtime overlay, combining committed node status, bound Copilot session status, tracker state, and PAW artifact status for PAW-backed sessions without turning graph.json into a telemetry log.

nodes.title: Launch and tracking usable on the graph
nodes.summary: A node can launch a PAW-backed Copilot CLI session into a visible terminal through an API-first launch pipeline after a launch configuration dialog, context assembly, SDK paw-init, prompt templating, CLI default resolution, and launch-claim creation; Streamliner binds the resulting registry entry back to the node, shows it grouped/linked in My Sessions, and renders matching session status on the graph without committing telemetry into workstream artifacts. The gate verifies that any brief-level Closeout Punch List items are completed, deferred, promoted, or dropped. Future CLI/skill/MCP agent launch surfaces and future non-Windows terminal adapters should call this same pipeline rather than inventing a second path.

checkpoints.title: Design foundation aligned
checkpoints.summary: Repo-scoped design docs exist and the workstream's explicit design direction is captured.

checkpoints.title: Manual session registry usable
checkpoints.summary: Streamliner persists a local, graph-independent registry of Copilot sessions with autosaved titles/descriptions/colors and can relaunch them after a restart.

checkpoints.title: Launch from graph works
checkpoints.summary: Streamliner assembles context, collects PAW workflow instructions and CLI defaults through a launch dialog, runs paw-init through Copilot SDK, creates and binds a launch claim, compiles the kickoff prompt with nonce/claim metadata, and launches a visible PAW-backed Copilot CLI interactive session from a node, registering it into the Wave 2 registry.

checkpoints.title: Tracking visible on the graph
checkpoints.summary: Streamliner links My Sessions and the graph through registry graphBinding metadata, overlays bound Copilot session status onto graph nodes with matching status pills/pulses, derives PAW workflow status from artifacts, and keeps telemetry out of graph.json.
